segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [quiet kitchen appliance hum] [softly] Let the eyes stay open. Imagine attention arriving in a small kitchen just before sunrise.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice five visible details as though morning light has found them for the first time.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Shape... colour... pattern... reflection... shadow. Let seeing return you to this room.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [soft fabric rustling] Find four touch sensations: fabric, floor, chair, temperature, weight, or the meeting of hands.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice three sounds, including the quiet mechanical sounds a home makes by itself.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Find two scents or air qualities. Perhaps clean, warm, cool, dry, familiar, or almost absent.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice one taste. Neutral is still a taste and ordinary is still present.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [thoughtfully] Let all five senses share one countertop of awareness. Nothing needs to dominate.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel both feet or the back of the body as one dependable surface.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Name the day, the place, and one thing you can do next without rushing.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Look around again and notice one detail that feels pleasant or simply okay.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Let morning continue. Move into the next moment with the room still around you.
